title: TE W. Ted Smith Jr. v. Central Carolina Presbytery
disposition_detail: The Committee on Judicial Business did not sustain TE W. Ted Smith Jr.'s complaint against Central Carolina Presbytery. The supplied excerpt states only that disposition and contains no issue-level rulings, adopted reasons, or remedial order.
first_summary: A presbytery was complained against for allegedly failing to enforce General Assembly orders restoring dismissed New Life congregation members and for tolerating the pastor’s evasions; the complainant asked for dissolution of the pastoral relation and censure. The Committee on Judicial Business rejected the complaint. No adopted reasons or remedial order appear in the supplied excerpt.
summary: A presbytery was challenged for allegedly failing to carry out General Assembly directives restoring dismissed New Life congregation members and for allowing the pastor and session to evade compliance; the complainant asked the Committee on Judicial Business to dissolve the pastoral relation and impose censure.
